name: smwpatches-sprite-height-fix-adjust
title: Sprite Height "Fix"/Adjust
description:
I was always irritated by the fact that certain sprites were one pixel lower than regular blocks, so I made a simple patch to correct this.

Makes a few sprites shift up by 1 pixel during the initialization routine of the Exploding Block, Turn Block Bridges, Info Box, Grey Moving Castle Block, Swooper Bat and Light Switch Block.
